summary: Delta's computer problem, which delayed many flights Sunday, has been fixed. The FBI crime database break-in and the USDA incident are still unexplained. Stocks and Bitcoin bounced after a hard drop, with no outage or attack reported. No official source links these events.

events.title: Delta Air Lines computer outage delays flights; system back up
events.impact: Delta used manual workarounds and the FAA briefly held Atlanta-bound flights. Delay counts differ by source, from about 700 to 3,500. Delta says its system is working again. Some delays may linger Monday.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays are not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant and missing-person checks. Reports do not say if it went down or if records were taken or changed.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI had not commented in the reports I saw. Reports rely on unnamed sources. Nothing links it to the September ShinyHunters jobs-portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan and payment tools were down for days. Officials expected most systems back late last week. I found no newer restoration update today.
events.stated_cause: A USDA official called it a cyberthreat. No attacker has been named and no one has said how it happened.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz at highest level of the conflict
events.impact: Projectiles hit three tankers Friday and Saturday, per a maritime risk firm. UK maritime monitors report fires and no casualties. Bahrain says Iran hit an industrial site.
events.stated_cause: Nobody has officially claimed the projectile hits. The risk firm says Iranian involvement is likely. Iran says one tanker hit a mine; that is unverified.

events.title: US stocks rebound in Sunday futures after worst week in years
events.impact: All three major US indexes ended Friday in correction territory. Sunday evening futures rose: Dow about 0.8-0.9%, S&P 500 about 1.1-1.5%, Nasdaq-100 about 1.9-2.5%. Markets open Monday. No trading halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI worries, Nvidia's CEO leaving and a report of an SEC accounting review. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin rebounds near 60.6K USD after Saturday dip to about 55.3K
events.impact: Price check: CoinGecko 60,612, Coinbase 60,906, Coinglass 60,691. Sources agree. Up 1-6% in 24h, down about 6-7% over 7 days. One report says it hit about 55,300 Saturday. Binance page near 79.7K looks stale. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports tie the drop to the stock selloff and leveraged bets being closed out.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 21:00 UTC Nov 22. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Microsoft explains Nov 12 global Microsoft 365 outage
events.impact: Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams and Copilot were disrupted for almost 24 hours. Microsoft published its full explanation Saturday.
events.stated_cause: Microsoft says a months-old software bug was triggered after Teams traffic moved to servers with less capacity. It says it was not a cyberattack.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Delta blamed its own weight and balance system, and the FAA said air traffic systems were not involved. The FBI and USDA break-ins have no stated cause or attacker. Stocks fell on AI and Nvidia news. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the FBI and USDA incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between incidents. Delta is fixed, and markets and Bitcoin are steadier.

prep_note: Thanksgiving travel is close, so check your flight status before leaving for the airport. Expect some leftover Delta delays Monday. If you rely on USDA farm programs, check for updates from your local office. Markets open Monday, so expect big price swings. Nothing here needs action beyond normal care.
